methods.label: Set the y-coordinate to zero
methods.explanation: Points on the \(x\)-axis have \(y\)-coordinate \(y=0\). Substituting this into \(y=2x-6\) gives \(2x-6=0\), so the \(x\)-coordinate of the intersection is the solution of the equation. Solving gives \(x=3\).
